map.和 CPI deflation？: How does it relate to CPI deflation?
map.CPI 用于消费项、平减用于全 GDP，覆盖范围不同，勿混用。结果仅作经济学教学: CPI covers consumption items while the deflator covers all of GDP; the coverage differs, so do not mix them.
